verdicts.reason: A really does rearrange the layout for the square, but it has clear flaws. The 'EXHIBITION' kicker is stranded to the right of the photo, away from the headline it introduces, so the reading order breaks. The black date box is indented and doesn't line up with the left edge of the headline and photo. The logo floats without aligning to the box's right edge, and there is dead space beside the photo. B is just the original portrait poster dropped into the middle of the square, leaving wide empty white bands on the left and right. The photo no longer runs to the canvas edges. Nothing was rearranged for the new format, and all the content is shrunk into a centre column.
